function.name: get_caller_profile
function.description: Look up the registered mobie passenger for the current caller.

function.name: find_location
function.description: Find Austrian address candidates for a departure or destination; present the candidates and ask which one the caller means.

function.name: confirm_location
function.description: Confirm a geocoder candidate only after speaking its name and hearing a clear yes from the caller.

function.name: search_rides
function.description: Search future mobie rides between the two caller-confirmed locations.

time.description: Future ISO-8601 date/time with Z or an explicit UTC offset; interpret the caller's time in Europe/Vienna.

function.name: prepare_booking
function.description: Prepare the full spoken trip summary for one ride from the latest search; this does not submit a request.

function.name: confirm_booking
function.description: Submit the prepared ride request only if the conversation contains the complete spoken summary followed by the caller's clear yes.
